output.model_sql:
WITH audience AS (
  SELECT customer_id, region, segment
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'customers') }}
  WHERE marketing_opt_in
),
damaged_customers AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'returns') }} r
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'orders') }} o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.reason = 'damaged' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.customer_id, a.region, a.segment
FROM audience a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM damaged_customers d WHERE d.customer_id = a.customer_id
)
output.notes: The CREATE becomes the audience CTE. The DELETE ... WHERE customer_id IN (subquery) is folded in as a NOT EXISTS anti-join. NOT EXISTS was chosen over NOT IN on purpose. In the legacy DELETE, a row whose customer_id is NULL evaluates 'NULL IN (...)' to NULL, so that row is never deleted and stays in the table. A plain 'customer_id NOT IN (...)' filter would drop those rows whenever the damaged list is non-empty. NOT EXISTS keeps them, which matches the legacy output. Duplicate customer rows are kept as-is, because the legacy job does not deduplicate either. Duplicate matches in the subquery do not change the anti-join result. Columns and their order match the legacy output: customer_id, region, segment.
quirks_found: Customers with NULL marketing_opt_in are excluded, because the WHERE clause on a NULL boolean filters them out.
Rows in raw.customers with a NULL customer_id survive the DELETE (NULL IN (...) is never true), so they stay in the audience.
Duplicate customer_id rows in raw.customers are not deduplicated and appear more than once in the audience.
The return reason match is exact and case-sensitive ('damaged'). Variants such as 'Damaged' or ' damaged ' do not exclude a customer.
Exclusion uses raw.orders rather than stg_orders_clean, so orders of any status (cancelled, test, duplicate loads) with a damaged return still exclude the customer.
Returns whose order_id does not exist in raw.orders are silently ignored by the inner join.
Any damaged return at any time excludes the customer permanently. There is no time window.
